thread:
oncall-bot: Pager — elevated 5xx on /v1/stream (canary) in prod-us-west-2 (error rate 18% over 5m) :rotating_light:

jamie: I'm seeing this after the 0.14 client rollout to 10% canary. Errors are `incomplete_frame` during streaming handshake.

sophie: oncall responding, pulling canary logs and trace IDs now. any deploy metadata?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: release/0.14 -> canary(10%) started by @taylor at 2026-03-15T12:03Z.

jamie: copying a representative error log:
```
2026-03-15T12:07:12Z ERROR stream-handler connection_id=abc1234 peer=client-0.14 "handshake: incomplete_frame, expected 4 bytes got 0"
2026-03-15T12:07:13Z WARN  kv-cache request_id=xyz789 delayed
```

kei: looks like client 0.14 changed the initial frame size/format for streaming start. router rejected on read loop. I can repro locally with 0.14 against canary build.

taylor: ack. Canary percentage was 10% traffic to the new client-side streaming change. rolling that back now unless we can flip a kill-switch.

jamie: we should kill the server-side acceptance of v2 streaming handshake until we fix compatibility. Can we flip feature flag `enable_streaming_v2` to `false` in prod-canary/primary?

kei: I can toggle at console. Command I use: `redwood feature-toggle set enable_streaming_v2 false --env prod --scope canary`

sophie: doing it now. will monitor. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sophie: toggled to false at 12:11Z. watching error rate.

oncall-bot: Metric alert cleared — /v1/stream 5xx rate dropped to 1.2% over 2m.

jamie: good. confirm whether customer-facing sessions dropped or only canary internal clients. liam, emily — can you surface any customer tickets or telemetry that indicates widespread impact?

liam: support saw two incoming tickets reporting dropped streaming sessions from customers on our SDK 0.14 alpha — both on canary regions. Not yet escalated. I'm drafting a notification.

emily: patching status page with "degraded streaming for some clients" and linking this thread.

taylor: I'll immediately abort the rest of the rollout (stop rollout job and mark release blocked). Also opening PR to revert the client-side handshake change — we may need a minor contract tweak rather than `v2` wire change.

kei: root cause summary: 0.14 introduced a new initial frame with an extra 2-byte prefix; server-side runtime in canary wasn't backward-compatible. Fix options: 1) server accept both frame formats (prefered), 2) roll back client change, 3) keep feature flag off until new protocol negotiated.

jamie: for now we keep `enable_streaming_v2=false` globally (prod canary and primary) so no further canary spikes. taylor please block rollout and create rollback artifact. kei & sophie please prepare a compatibility patch that allows dual-handshake detection.

taylor: rollout aborted and release marked "hold" in releases dashboard @12:22Z.

sophie: starting a quick patch: add handshake detector that checks the first 2 bytes; if pattern unknown, fallback to v1 parser. I'll run unit + integration tests in staging and push to canary after approval.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Incident severity = S2 (service degradation affecting subset of customers). Paging will remain open until post-mortem assigned.

jamie: owners: taylor (release), kei (runtime fix), sophie (patch + test). liam/emily for customer comms. I'll take incident lead and track.

liam: notifying the two customers who filed tickets and offering rollback help. mentioning temporary mitigation (disable v2 flag).

emily: status page updated and slack #customers-affected ping queued.

jamie: next steps:
- immediate: keep kill-switch false, block rollout, notify customers (in progress)
- short term: dual-handshake patch to accept both formats -> canary test -> promote
- medium: add automated contract test between SDK client and server on our CI to catch this before canary
- follow-up: postmortem with timeline, RCA, and remediation (owner: jamie)

kei: I'll open the runtime PR and include benchmark to ensure no perf regressions.

taylor: ETA for rollback artifact: 30m, patch ETA: ~3h, canary test ~1h after patch.

jamie: handing off to the evening oncall at 18:00 UTC — @sophie please do a handoff update 30m before. If anything spikes, page oncall (SRE).

sophie: will do. adding a short runbook to the incident doc: steps to flip feature flag, how to check metrics, and rollback link.

jamie: thanks all. keeping thread open until postmortem is posted. :white_check_mark:
